axes.label: T-Key Usage
axes.y_axis_label_raw: Fraction of ticks with active T-key target lock
axes.description: Share of UpdateTick samples where the player had an active T-key target lock. Tap-toggled per nearest enemy; persists until target dies or breaks range.

axes.label: Mobility (activity_score)
axes.description: Positioning-derived activity_score divided by 100. Combines movement, area coverage, and base-time penalties.

axes.label: Thug Accuracy (weapon-normalized)
axes.y_axis_label_raw: Weapon-normalized accuracy ratio vs lobby (1.0 = baseline)
axes.description: Per-weapon hit-rate ratio vs lobby baseline, weighted by shot share. PvE hits credited at ALPHA_PVE.

axes.label: Thug Efficiency
axes.description: Dogfight damage efficiency. Structure damage excluded from denominator (rewarded separately via pve_share).

axes.label: PvE Share
axes.description: Share of player damage dealt to non-human assets (structures + mobile AI).

axes.label: Net Damage Share
axes.description: Player's net damage divided by total lobby-dealt damage. Negative when received exceeds dealt.

axes.label: Snipe Bonus (capped)
axes.description: Sniper-rifle kills divided by 5, capped at 1.0 before z-score so an outlier can't deform the lobby distribution.
